alt.en: A sepia studio photograph of ten African American singers in formal dress of the 1870s: five women sit in long ruffled gowns around a small carved table, and a sixth woman and four men stand behind them, before a painted backdrop of columns and trees. Their names are printed below the picture.
alt.es: Fotografía de estudio en tono sepia de diez cantantes afroamericanos con ropa formal de la década de 1870: cinco mujeres sentadas con vestidos largos de volantes alrededor de una mesita tallada y, detrás, otra mujer y cuatro hombres de pie, ante un telón pintado con columnas y árboles. Debajo de la imagen están impresos sus nombres.

caption.en: The Jubilee Singers of Fisk University, named beneath, in the photograph mounted at the front of J. B. T. Marsh's The Story of the Jubilee Singers (sixth edition, London, 1876), the book whose 1875 edition holds Deep River's earliest known printing.
caption.es: Los Jubilee Singers de la Universidad Fisk, con sus nombres debajo, en la fotografía montada al principio de The Story of the Jubilee Singers de J. B. T. Marsh (sexta edición, Londres, 1876), el libro cuya edición de 1875 contiene la primera impresión conocida de Deep River.

source: J. B. T. Marsh, The Story of the Jubilee Singers; with Their Songs (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1876), frontispiece, a mounted photograph; names printed beneath: Maggie Porter, E. W. Watkins, H. D. Alexander, F. J. Loudin, Thomas Rutling, Jennie Jackson, Mabel Lewis, Ella Sheppard, Maggie Carnes, America W. Robinson
library: Getty Research Institute (digitized by the Internet Archive)
callNumber: Internet Archive storyofjubileesi00mars_3, image n7; Getty 9927194460001551; OCLC 1435505056
licenceEvidence: Photograph published in London in 1876 as the book's frontispiece (record: "Frontispiece portrait of the Jubilee Singers is a mounted photograph"); photographer not named. PD by age in the US (published before 1931), the UK/EU and Israel (anonymous: 70 years from publication; any photographer active in 1876 died long before 1956). Everyone shown died long ago. See rights.md.
credit: Getty Research Institute, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: A printed page headed "No. 77. Deep River." in black-letter type: three lines of a tune on one staff, with four sharps and in common time, and the words "Deep river, My home is over Jordan, Deep river, Lord, I want to cross over into camp ground, Lord, I" under the notes. The page number, 196, is at the foot.
alt.es: Página impresa con el encabezado "No. 77. Deep River." en letra gótica: tres líneas de una melodía en un solo pentagrama, con cuatro sostenidos y en compasillo, y la letra "Deep river, My home is over Jordan, Deep river, Lord, I want to cross over into camp ground, Lord, I" bajo las notas. Al pie está el número de página, 196.

caption.en: Deep River as No. 77 in Marsh's The Story of the Jubilee Singers, page 196 of the sixth edition (London, 1876), which prints it, as a bare tune, on the same pages as the 1875 second edition, its earliest known printing.
caption.es: Deep River como n.º 77 en The Story of the Jubilee Singers de Marsh, página 196 de la sexta edición (Londres, 1876), que la imprime, como melodía sola, en las mismas páginas que la segunda edición de 1875, su primera impresión conocida.

source: J. B. T. Marsh, The Story of the Jubilee Singers; with Their Songs (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1876), No. 77, "Deep River", p. 196 (the No. 77 part of the page)
library: Getty Research Institute (digitized by the Internet Archive)
callNumber: Internet Archive storyofjubileesi00mars_3, image n209; Getty 9927194460001551; OCLC 1435505056
licenceEvidence: Published London 1876; a traditional tune and words set down by the Fisk singers' transcribers (Theodore F. Seward died 1902); Marsh's own text is not on this crop. PD in the US (before 1931), the EU and Israel. Faithful scan of a flat page. See rights.md.
credit: Getty Research Institute, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: The first page of printed sheet music headed "Deep River", with "Respectfully dedicated to Miss Mary Jordan" above it and "Old Negro melody, Arranged by H. T. Burleigh" at the right. Three systems for voice and piano in F major are marked Lento, with the words "Deep river, my home is over Jordan, Deep river, Lord, I want to cross over into camp-ground." A copyright line for 1917 and G. Ricordi is at the foot.
alt.es: Primera página de una partitura impresa con el título "Deep River", con "Respectfully dedicated to Miss Mary Jordan" encima y "Old Negro melody, Arranged by H. T. Burleigh" a la derecha. Tres sistemas para voz y piano en Fa mayor llevan la indicación Lento, con la letra "Deep river, my home is over Jordan, Deep river, Lord, I want to cross over into camp-ground." Al pie hay una línea de copyright de 1917 a nombre de G. Ricordi.

caption.en: The first page of Harry T. Burleigh's Deep River for voice and piano, in F for high voice (New York: G. Ricordi, copyright 1917): the solo setting, registered in 1916, that became the best known of his spirituals.
caption.es: La primera página del Deep River de Harry T. Burleigh para voz y piano, en Fa para voz aguda (Nueva York: G. Ricordi, copyright 1917): el arreglo para voz sola, registrado en 1916, que se convirtió en el más conocido de sus espirituales.

source: H. T. Burleigh, arr., Deep River: Old Negro Melody, for high voice and piano (New York: G. Ricordi & Co., 1917), plate 116059, p. 3
library: Harold B. Lee Library, Brigham Young University (digitized by the Internet Archive)
callNumber: Internet Archive deepriveroldnegr00newy, image n2; BYU record a3866408
licenceEvidence: Published New York 1917 ("Copyright MCMXVII by G. Ricordi & Co., Inc."); arranger H. T. Burleigh died 1949; words and tune traditional. PD in the US (published before 1931) and, as Burleigh died in 1949, in the EU and Israel (life plus 70) since 1 January 2020. See rights.md.
credit: Harold B. Lee Library, Brigham Young University, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: A black-and-white photograph looking along a wide, calm river. Thick bushes and trees line the left bank down to the water, and pale, steep clay cliffs rise above the right bank.
alt.es: Fotografía en blanco y negro de un río ancho y tranquilo, visto a lo largo de su cauce. Matorrales y árboles espesos bordean la orilla izquierda hasta el agua, y sobre la orilla derecha se alzan acantilados de arcilla, claros y empinados.

caption.en: The river Jordan, looking upstream, photographed between about 1900 and 1919 by the American Colony's Photo Department in Jerusalem (Library of Congress, Matson Collection): the river of the song, which the Israelites crossed into the promised land.
caption.es: El río Jordán, mirando río arriba, fotografiado aproximadamente entre 1900 y 1919 por el departamento de fotografía de la American Colony de Jerusalén (Biblioteca del Congreso, colección Matson): el río de la canción, que los israelitas cruzaron para entrar en la tierra prometida.

source: River Jordan; Looking up the River Jordan (1 negative, glass, stereograph, dry plate, 5 x 7 in.; one half used); photographer: American Colony (Jerusalem), Photo Department
library: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, G. Eric and Edith Matson Photograph Collection
